title: opencode-secrets registry
description: Registry for the opencode-secrets OpenCode server plugin. Lives at ~/.config/opencode/opencode-secrets.json by default (path overridable via the plugin's `registry` option). The plugin ignores unknown root keys, so a `$schema` pointer is safe.

$schema.description: Optional. Point at this schema file for editor validation, e.g. ./plugins/opencode-secrets/registry.schema.json

items.description: Exactly one of content/value/env is required. Invalid regex entries are skipped with a console warning; entries with fewer than 6 characters of value are ignored.

friendlyName.description: Label shown in the placeholder: $$FRIENDLYNAME_12CHARS$$. Sanitized to A-Z0-9.

type.description: plain: content/value is a literal secret. regex: content is a regular expression.

mode.description: obfuscate: reversible $$LABEL_12CHARS$$ placeholder, restored into tool inputs. replace: one-way same-length rewrite that never restores.

content.description: The secret (type plain) or pattern (type regex). Regex entries also accept /pattern/flags literal form. Values under 6 characters are ignored.

env.description: Read the secret from this environment variable at store build time (plain only).

replacement.description: Fixed replacement text for mode=replace entries (regex and plain alike). Regex entries without one get a same-length scrambled rewrite that provably does not re-trigger the pattern.

flags.description: RegExp flags for type=regex entries, e.g. "i". Ignored for plain entries.

envScan.description: Optional opt-in scan of environment variables (pi-style implicit scan). Absent = no env scan.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive, unanchored name pattern, e.g. (KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|PASS|AUTH|CREDENTIAL|PRIVATE|OAUTH)(_|$). Include (_|$) to enforce a word boundary so KEY does not match MONKEY.

minLength.description: Minimum env value length to register.
